verdict.rationale: Weave ships a Playground built for iterating on LLM prompts and responses. It offers prompt editing, message retrying and side-by-side model comparison, can run against real provider models or custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints, and supports reusable saved model presets. Missing for 10: no evidence of prompt variables or templating in the Playground, and no independent or hands-on corroboration beyond the vendor docs.
